text_zh: 岳王庙普通入园是否须预约、提前天数及每周是否有固定闭馆日，本库均未核定。现有资料只有杭州政协网转载的2023年8月7日《每日商报》报道；按本库来源分级，政府网站转载的新闻报道只作补充，不能单独支撑开放或闭馆规则。行前请查看景区最新安排；内部岳飞纪念馆和西湖湖岸的规则不能代替岳王庙的规则。
text_en: Whether ordinary admission to Yue Fei Temple needs a reservation, how far ahead it can be booked, and whether it has a fixed weekly closing day are not confirmed here. The only material found is a Meiri Shangbao (每日商报) report from 7 August 2023 republished on Hangzhou’s CPPCC portal; under this catalogue’s source tiers, a news report republished on a government site is supplementary only and cannot on its own establish opening or closing rules. Check the attraction’s latest arrangements before travelling. Rules for the internal Yue Fei Memorial Museum or West Lake’s lakeshore do not establish the temple’s rules.
